# Which recorded paths of the profile read grant end up carrying a
# session's read deny. Read by the library's tests and by srt-win's:
# the library ranks a session's lists and hands srt-win the result
# (`handed-*`); srt-win writes each handed deny on itself and on the
# recorded paths beneath it, except those the handed grants allow more
# specifically. `expect` is the outcome both must agree on.
#
# One case per block. `recorded` is `kind path`; lists are separated
# by ` | `; a path is given beneath `P`, the profile directory, which
# stands for `C:\Users\me` (`P` alone is the profile itself).

recorded: container P | granted P\Documents | granted P\proj | file P\.npmrc | container P\.cargo | file P\.cargo\config.toml | denied P\.ssh | container P\AppData | container P\AppData\Local | granted P\AppData\Local\Programs | ungranted P\AppData\Local\Temp | skipped P\link

case: a deny on the profile reaches every recorded allow
deny: P
handed-deny: P
expect: P | P\Documents | P\proj | P\.npmrc | P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml | P\AppData | P\AppData\Local | P\AppData\Local\Programs

case: a recorded directory the session allows for reading keeps its allow
read: P\proj
deny: P
handed-read: P\proj
handed-deny: P
expect: P | P\Documents | P\.npmrc | P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml | P\AppData | P\AppData\Local | P\AppData\Local\Programs

case: a recorded directory that is the session's write root keeps its allow
write: P\proj
deny: P
handed-write: P\proj
handed-deny: P
expect: P | P\Documents | P\.npmrc | P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml | P\AppData | P\AppData\Local | P\AppData\Local\Programs

case: an allow beneath a recorded directory does not spare the directory
read: P\Documents\work
deny: P
handed-read: P\Documents\work
handed-deny: P
expect: P | P\Documents | P\proj | P\.npmrc | P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml | P\AppData | P\AppData\Local | P\AppData\Local\Programs

case: an allow on a container spares what is recorded beneath it
read: P\AppData
deny: P
handed-read: P\AppData
handed-deny: P
expect: P | P\Documents | P\proj | P\.npmrc | P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml

case: a deny beneath an allow beneath a deny
read: P\AppData
deny: P | P\AppData\Local
handed-read: P\AppData
handed-deny: P | P\AppData\Local
expect: P | P\Documents | P\proj | P\.npmrc | P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml | P\AppData\Local | P\AppData\Local\Programs

case: a grant beneath a second, deeper deny that an upper grant lies above
read: P\AppData | P\AppData\Local\Programs
deny: P | P\AppData\Local
handed-read: P\AppData | P\AppData\Local\Programs
handed-deny: P | P\AppData\Local
except: P\AppData | P\AppData\Local\Programs
expect: P | P\Documents | P\proj | P\.npmrc | P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml | P\AppData\Local

case: an allow on the denied path itself does not win
read: P\Documents
deny: P\Documents
handed-read: P\Documents
handed-deny: P\Documents
expect: P\Documents

case: an allow above the deny changes nothing beneath it
read: P\AppData
deny: P\.cargo
handed-read: P\AppData
handed-deny: P\.cargo
expect: P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml

case: a credential file outranks the allow on it
read: P\.npmrc | P\proj
credential: P\.npmrc
handed-read: P\proj
handed-deny: P\.npmrc
expect: P\.npmrc

case: an allow at or beneath a credential entry is not handed over at all
write: P\proj
deny: P
credential: P\proj
handed-deny: P | P\proj
expect: P | P\Documents | P\proj | P\.npmrc | P\.cargo | P\.cargo\config.toml | P\AppData | P\AppData\Local | P\AppData\Local\Programs

case: paths are compared as objects, not as spelled
read: P\APPDATA\local\programs
deny: P\appdata\
handed-read: P\APPDATA\local\programs
handed-deny: P\appdata\
expect: P\AppData | P\AppData\Local

case: a deny beneath a granted directory needs nothing more
deny: P\Documents\secret
handed-deny: P\Documents\secret
expect:

case: no deny
read: P\proj
handed-read: P\proj
expect:
